values.note: Forest Service dispersed camping: no reservations or fee. Monongahela rules: no more than 14 cumulative days at one site within a 28-day period, then move more than 5 road miles or wait 21 days; vehicles must stay on or adjacent to roads open to public travel. Camping is prohibited within 300 ft of FR 19 and FR 75 in the Dolly Sods Wilderness and Scenic Area (Red Creek Campground excepted).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/general-use-restrictions (Forest Order: 'Camping outside developed campgrounds at any one campsite in excess of fourteen (14) cumulative days within a 28-day period, then relocating the camp within five (5) road miles of the site just occupied without a waiting period of three weeks (21 days)') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/dolly-sods-wilderness-and-scenic-areas (Order 21-94: 'Camping within 300 feet of Forest Road 19 and/or Forest Road 75, excluding the Red Creek Campground') + Monongahela NF release reprinted by Parsons Advocate 2023-04-24 (https://parsonsadvocate.com/news/pa-top-stories/headlines/monongahela-national-forest-issues-reminder-about-camping-and-food-storage-regulations/: dispersed camping 'is free of charge anywhere in the national forest outside of a designated campground'; 'All vehicles must remain on or adjacent to roadways that are open to public travel'), read 2026-10-21

summary: No Forest Service page designates these roadside sites; booking set from the Monongahela's dispersed-camping rules: first-come, no reservations, 14 days in 28 (reservable false / fcfs confirmed). The forest's Dolly Sods order bans camping within 300 ft of FR 19/FR 75 in the Wilderness and Scenic Area, flagged. No FS statement on road conditions or 4WD for FR 19/75. Free fees left. Not stated: season, facilities. Note left as is.
flags: Criteria / legality (human decides; possible DROP): Monongahela Forest Order 21-94 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/dolly-sods-wilderness-and-scenic-areas, read 2026-10-21) prohibits 'Camping within 300 feet of Forest Road 19 and/or Forest Road 75, excluding the Red Creek Campground' in the Dolly Sods Wilderness and Dolly Sods Scenic Area. The pinned point sits on FR 19 (OSM: 'Laneville North Fork Road', Grant County), apparently on the southern approach from Jordan Run Road; if it lies inside the order's mapped area, roadside camping there is prohibited.

Missing agency page: no Forest Service page designates these sites, and the forest's own list of developed-dispersed camping areas (Cheat-Potomac RD: Gandy Creek, Lower Glady, Canaan Loop Road; 2023 release) names none at Dolly Sods. Best agency pages: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/dolly-sods-wilderness and the dispersed rules in https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/general-use-restrictions. Missing phone: Cheat-Potomac Ranger District (304) 257-4488 (same release).

Road caveat: FR 19 is closed for maintenance from the gate near Laneville to the FR 75 intersection since June 22, 2026 (alert runs to June 15, 2027; 'Access to the Dolly Sods Wilderness is still available from FR19 via Jordan Run Rd near Hopeville'). The site appears to be on the open Jordan Run side; confirm.
